value: melatonin accumulates in plantlets grown under blue LED light (sentence covers all Scutellaria species tested, S. galericulata among them; also detectable under white LED)
method: in vitro plantlets grown under white, blue and other LED spectra, melatonin measured

source.authors: Forsyth JA, Erland LAE, Shipley PR, Murch SJ
source.title: Plant perception of light: the role of indoleamines in Scutellaria species

quote: All of the Scutellaria species accumulated MEL when grown under blue LED lights (Figure 2a, b, c).
note: Genus-level sentence naming all species in the study; the species-specific sentence in Section 3.2 is 'S. galericulata and S. lateriflora plantlets had detectable MEL when grown under white LED spectra (Figure 2b, c).' Melatonin as a light-perception signal is the paper's framing; no diel or circadian result for Scutellaria.
